task: Create and integrate the protocol and public-memory chapter of the 20-scene Starlight Field Notes visual system.
surface: Starlight Intelligence Org /field-notes institutional editorial experience
audience: Protocol implementers, operators, collaborators, and public-source evaluators
first_read: Keep proof, human authority, forkability, and public memory in one visible relationship.

references.label: Starlight reference character set
references.reason: Extend the shared character family into civic, archival, and governance roles.

direction.signature: A restrained starlight trace moves from source record to human attestation and public return.

asset_quality.why_premium: Six individually directed institutional scenes center human authority and preserve clear distinctions between memory, protocol, attestation, forkability, and public stewardship.

artifacts.notes: Six normalized 1120x1400 WebP exports below 240 KB.
Vercel preview inspected at desktop and 390x844 mobile; six cards and all six images render with zero horizontal overflow.

checks.name: export-inspection
checks.evidence: All public-memory crops inspected in the production contact sheet.

checks.name: visual-qa
checks.evidence: Desktop and mobile preview captures pass hierarchy, crop, copy, navigation, image-load, and overflow checks; no route console errors.

score.notes: Custom media, institutional restraint, responsive behavior, and static fallback pass the premium gate.

known_risks: Cross-domain links should be released as one coordinated set.
The dense forkability scene remains a late-chapter card, never a hero claim.
The available browser surfaces report coarse pointer, so the fine-pointer GSAP path is source-verified while the static fallback is preview-verified.
